newsitem.title: USA: HP hopes for higher order growth.
newsitem.headline: HP hopes for higher order growth.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co's chief financial officer Robert Wayman said the company would be satisfied by order growth rates in the mid to high teens in the near future

Wayman said in a presentation to investors at a Montgomery Securities conference that the order rates should recover modestly from the eight percent growth experienced in its recent July quarter, he said.

This third quarter order growth rate was down sharply from 35 percent order growth in the prior year third quarter and down sequentially from 24 percent order growth in the second quarter of fiscal 1996.
"Going forward we would be pleased to see order growth in the mid- to high-teens," Wayman told investors.
